title: Yateemo ka sahara
body:
aaj kufe ke yateemo ka sahara na raha
haye abbas e almadar ka baba na raha
<<DIVIDER>>
aasman rone laga gham ki hawa aisi chali
shor masjid se utha haye ali haye ali
sab ka hamdard tha jo aaj wo maula na raha
haye abbas e almadar ka...
aaj kufe ke yateemo ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi masjid mein namazi pe sitamgaari hai
sar shikasta hai qayamat hai lahoo jaari hai
bhar gaya khoon musalla bhi musalla na raha
haye abbas e almadar ka...
aaj kufe ke yateemo ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
sahar ke waqt bhi chaaye hai andhere kaise
dekh kar suye baqayya ye kaha zainab ne
dekho amma meri dunya mein ujaala na raha
haye abbas e almadar ka...
aaj kufe ke yateemo ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon mein doob gaya hai jo ali ka chehra
ibne muljim ne sitam hai ye khuda par dhaaya
jis se zaahir tha khuda aaj wo chehra na raha
haye abbas e almadar ka...
aaj kufe ke yateemo ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
manzar e shaam e ghariban ki alamat ban kar
ye sahar aayi hai zainab pe qayamat ban kar
sar pe chadar hai magar baap ka saaya na raha
haye abbas e almadar ka...
aaj kufe ke yateemo ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab bhi amma ki judaai ne rulaya hum ko
haye baba ne diya aa ke dilaasa hum ko
aaj dene ke liye koi dilaasa na raha
haye abbas e almadar ka...
aaj kufe ke yateemo ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ke sar ko jo zaanu pe hassan ne rakha
dekh kar band nigahon ko tadap kar ye kaha
haye baba na rahe koi hamara na raha
haye abbas e almadar ka...
aaj kufe ke yateemo ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
dil ye phat jayega zeeshan mera ro ro kar
shadman gham ye qayamat hai ali waalon par
kis tarha sabr kare sabr ka yaara na raha
haye abbas e almadar ka...
aaj kufe ke yateemo ka...
author: Zeeshan Abidi
